<Video 1> is the source video for the editing task: one continuous vertical studio dance performance, approximately 81 seconds long. A solo adult man dances on a white seamless paper sweep in front of a large off-white backdrop. Numerous translucent soap bubbles drift continuously across the foreground, around the performer, and against the backdrop. The camera is fixed in a high, slightly downward-looking vertical view, capturing his full body and the floor. Parts of the studio, including dark floor areas, side lighting stands and the edges of the paper backdrop, remain visible at the sides of the frame.

<Picture 1> is the character reference sheet: its facial close-up and front, side and back full-body views show the same adult woman, her distinctive hairstyle, facial features, accessories and complete outfit.

<Subject 1> is the adult woman shown in <Picture 1>. She has a large, voluminous dark-brown natural-texture afro arranged in two rounded lobes with a central part, creating a distinctive bow-like silhouette. She has expressive brown eyes, vivid green eyeshadow, black winged eyeliner, defined brows, warm blush and full red lips. She wears large faceted spherical green earrings, layered pearl and gold necklaces, a structured gold ribbed high-neck top with matching textured cuffs and hem, a fitted deep-red sleeveless tailored vest, and a brown leopard-print long-sleeved blouse with a sculptural leopard-print ruffle over one shoulder and down the front. She wears dark straight-leg black jeans and brown leather ankle boots with low block heels. Her face, hairstyle, makeup, accessories, outfit, proportions and visible front, profile and back details match <Picture 1> and remain stable throughout the entire video.

Maintain stable facial identity and a coherent two-lobed afro silhouette without morphing, duplication, disappearing accessories or wardrobe changes.
